transcript: The horse was put inside the chamber before it started to kick around. You see, it had a serious disease and the pressurized oxygen inside was supposed to help it heal faster. But, when it [music] kicked, one of the lids was knocked off, exposing the metal underneath. And as one of its horseshoes hit the bare wall, it created a spark, which was turned into a flame by the oxygen. This lit the horse on fire and as the pressure quickly rose, the chamber exploded, killing both the horse and the person in charge.
